title: miliusa roxburghiana
intro: Miliusa roxburghiana, commonly known as the Roxburgh's Milu or the Roxburgh's Miliusa, is a plant species found in the Himalayan region. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Miliusa roxburghiana include its antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it useful in treating fever, inflammation, and malaria. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects.
